newsitem.title: USA: SoCal Edison nuclear unit 2 at full power.
newsitem.headline: SoCal Edison nuclear unit 2 at full power.

text.p: Edison International's Southern California Edison Co. said Monday the 1,080 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear plant was back to full power after restarting, as expectd, on Saturday.
The unit was shut September 24 for unplanned repairs to stop a leak in the reactor's coolant system. It was initially expected to be down for two weeks but repairs were extended.
The San Onofre plant's other operating unit, the 1,070 MW unit 3, is scheduled to shut for a 70-day refueling on November 30.
Edison has a 75 percent stake in the nuclear plant, while San Diego Gas and Electric Co owns 20 percent and two municipal utilities own the remaining 5 percent.
